senses.gloss: --the burning ground; the name of Avi- mukta; those who regard Benares as such will be deluding themselves; those who die there attain release. M. १८४. 5, १९-21, ६३.
--a son of वसिष्ठ and a प्रजापति of the स्वारो- चिष epoch. M. 9. 9. [page३-721+ २९]
(I)--a son of देवकी killed by Kamsa: taken back to द्वारका: after embracing by mother goes to heaven with his five brothers. भा. X. ८५. ५१ and ५६.

--promulgated by Manu at the beginning of त्रेतायुग; traditional dharma of the family and precepts of conduct constituting वर्णाश्रम and आचारलक्षण; deals with वर्णाश्रम, yama and niyama; remembrance is स्मार्त;
1: Br. II. २९. ४४-60; ३२. ३३-44; III. २१. ४७. M. १४२. ४२; वा. ५७. ३९, ४१-45.
ety. introduced after the manvan- tara by remembering the old आचारस्; by once more calling to mind the practices of previous epochs principally of वर्नाश्रम.
2: Ib. ५९. ३२, ३८.
